👮 Let me start with something people might not expect from a Reform councillor: recorded crime went DOWN.

In the year to March 2026, recorded theft fell 8%, shoplifting fell 4%, burglary fell 9% and vehicle crime fell 11%. Those are real falls and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. ✅

But here's the figure underneath them: only 18% of offences now result in a charge. A decade ago, in 2014-15, it was 36.3%. ⚖️

A victim's chance of seeing anybody charged has been cut in half. And fewer than one in five shopliftings is solved.

Ask a shopkeeper why they stopped reporting it. They won't give you a criminology answer — they'll tell you nothing happened the last four times. 🛒

Some of that fall is progress. Some of it is surrender being recorded as success.

My honest read 👇
